ModMetaData.name: Implant Salvage
ModMetaData.author: Luke
ModMetaData.description:
Bionics no longer die with their owner. Right-click a corpse with a doctor selected and pull the implant out.
In vanilla, a raider with an archotech arm and a bionic heart drops a corpse worth nothing - the parts only survive if you capture him alive. Implant Salvage lets a doctor recover them from the body instead.
- Right-click a corpse with a colonist selected and pick the implant by name, e.g. "Bionic arm (left arm)". - Only pawns who actually do Doctor work can be ordered to do it. Anyone else gets a greyed-out option explaining why. - Skill matters: the chance of wrecking the implant runs from about 45% at Medicine 0 down to a 2% floor at Medicine 15+, using the same surgery-success stat as real operations, so traits and injuries count too. - Failure destroys the implant. Choose your surgeon. - One implant per order, exactly like installing one. No "salvage everything" button. - Works at any rot stage, right up until the corpse deteriorates away. - Implants only. Natural organs are left alone, so no organ-harvesting mood or ideology fallout.
Works on humans, xenotypes and ghouls (ghouls yield adrenal, corrosive and metalblood hearts - grafted plating and barbs are not recoverable, matching vanilla). Modded prosthetics are picked up automatically.
MULTIPLAYER Multiplayer-safe by design, and needs no compatibility patch.
Does not require Harmony.
